text: Call `connect_db(dsn)` to open a pooled session; if the server does not respond within the default 5 seconds timeout, a ConnectionTimeoutError is raised.
Transient 503 responses are automatically retried up to 3 times as controlled by `max_retry_attempt` before surfacing an error to the caller.
For older v1 integrations, authenticate requests by passing your static key in the `X-Legacy-Token` header via the legacy token authentication provider.
Use `flush_batch(items)` to flush pending records to storage and return the count of written items.
